Hi Marissa,

We’re getting close to our first month of usage and need to confirm how Redwood will invoice Fabrika GmbH. A couple things Finance needs confirmed before we can approve the invoice flow:

- Which entity will be listed on the invoice (we prefer the German legal entity).
- Whether Redwood can issue an invoice under reverse-charge (we have a valid VAT ID) or if you require self-billing.
- Any data you need to support VAT validation (VAT ID, registration country, billing address).

I’ve copied our accounting address and will attach our VAT certificate if helpful.

Thanks,

Hi Anna — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear checklist. Short answers up front and then a proposed next step:

- Invoice entity: we can bill Fabrika GmbH (German entity) — please confirm the registered address and company registry number if you want that printed on the invoice.
- Reverse-charge: yes, we can apply reverse-charge on EU B2B transactions provided the VAT ID validates. Please attach the VAT certificate (looks like you already did).
- Self-billing: Redwood supports self-billing agreements for enterprise customers. That requires a signed self-billing form and a short account-change request.
- PO handling: we can include PO #5507 on the invoice. If you need the amount split between entities or cost centers, please provide the allocation matrix.

Next step: I’ll validate the VAT ID with our finance team and confirm whether we will issue a standard invoice with reverse-charge or proceed with self-billing. Can you confirm:
1) Legal company name exactly as it should appear on the invoice
2) Registered address for billing
3) Company registry number (if applicable)

I’ll loop in finance (Jonas) and collections (Ben) for any follow-ups about PO and net terms.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
